english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for strong enthusiasm or passionate interest, especially in “curb your enthusiasm.”

exampleSentences.english: They are full of enthusiasm for this project.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢對呢個計劃充滿熱情。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 cung1 mun5 jit6 cing4

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for strong enthusiasm, fervor, or warm positive passion.

exampleSentences.english: He has a real passion for teaching children.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢對教小朋友好有熱情。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 gaau3 siu2 pang4 jau5 hou2 jau5 jit6 cing4

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for enthusiasm or passionate enjoyment, especially in a general description.

exampleSentences.english: They have always had a lot of gusto for making desserts.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢對做甜品一直都好有熱情。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zou6 tim4 ban2 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 jau5 jit6 cing4

english.note: Use this when the exuberance is mainly enthusiastic warmth or eagerness rather than physical liveliness.

exampleSentences.english: They welcome every customer with such exuberance.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢用熱情招呼每一位客人。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 jit6 cing4 ziu1 fu1 mui5 jat1 wai6 haak3 jan4

english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on enthusiasm or passionate commitment rather than sheer energy.

exampleSentences.english: Their verve for theatre drew the whole cast in.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢對舞台劇嘅熱情，令成隊人都投入晒。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 mou5 toi4 kek6 ge3 jit6 cing4 ling6 seng4 deoi6 jan4 dou1 tau4 jap6 saai3

english.note: Use 熱情 when the warmth means strong emotional involvement, enthusiasm, or fervor in expression.

exampleSentences.english: When they talk about their job, their voice is full of warmth.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢講到自己份工，語氣充滿熱情。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 dou3 zi6 gei2 fan6 gung1 jyu5 hei3 cung1 mun5 jit6 cing4

english.note: Use this when flame means passion, zeal, enthusiasm, or excitement.

exampleSentences.english: His flame for painting has come back。

english.note: Use this for emotional warmth or ardour rather than a visible glow.

exampleSentences.english: Her warmth gave the whole room a warm glow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢待人嗰份熱情，令成間屋都有種溫暖嘅感覺。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 doi6 jan4 go2 fan2 jit6 cing4 ling6 sing4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 jau5 zung2 wan1 nyun5 ge3 gam2 gok3

english.note: Use 熱情 when “fire” means positive passion or creative and intellectual enthusiasm.

exampleSentences.english: This teacher has real fire for teaching.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢位老師對教學好有熱情。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 wai2 lou5 si1 deoi3 gaau3 hok6 hou2 jau5 jit6 cing4
